# Image attributions

## Status (2026-08-25)

`ambiance1.jpg`, `ambiance2.jpg`, and `ambiance3.jpg` are genuine
Gemini generations as of 2026-08-25 (generated via the
`gemini-image-generator` tool), replacing generic reused
coffee/window and living-room stock photos. Hero was already genuine,
custom, and well-matched.

- `ambiance1.jpg`: a single wood screw beside a matching
  wing-nut-and-bolt pair. Metaphor: a script versus a reusable
  function.
- `ambiance2.jpg`: a single labeled drawer pulled open in a wooden
  cabinet, revealing several identical small tools. Metaphor: a
  personal toolbox.
- `ambiance3.jpg`: a pegboard holding a fixed, single-purpose tool
  and a multi-bit adjustable tool side by side. Metaphor: a rigid
  script versus a flexible function.

All three processed via `magick -resize 1600x -strip -quality 85` to
1600x873.
